boundary.why_not: this record is a STRUCTURAL probe, not a boundary measurement.  The two-tile dependent chain cannot be simulated yet because two of the five terms of section 3.6 have no RTL: a partial COLLECTOR driving ot_a3_tree_endpoint_fp32's leaf port from ot_a3_tile64's partial port, and a RECEIVER writing a tree root into a consumer tile's activation FIFO and advancing its act_ready_kblocks.  Measured on both elaborators against the vehicle results/rtl/abi3_tile64.json qualified the tile in: part_we, op_retire, act_wr_en are internal nets of ot_a3_tile64_top and cannot be connected to from outside, while tree_in_leaf, tree_in_valid, tree_out_data are ports -- the reduction endpoint's operands are driven from outside the vehicle, which is what abi3_tile64.json already says in its own words: bit_identity.basis, 'every tree root is the RE8 endpoint's output over the CAPTURED partials', and design.tree_endpoint, 'instantiated beside the tile in the top (never inside)'.  Its claim_boundary.does_not_establish.tree_span records the other half -- 'the design's tree spans tiles and its hop latency is not modelled'.  A boundary measured on a chain whose two missing blocks were improvised for the measurement would be a measurement of the improvisation, and section 13 item 13 forbids exactly that shape of number

does_not_establish.any_figure_for_the_missing_blocks: no estimate of what a collector or a receiver would cost is made.  Estimating one and charging it into technology.json is the fit section 13 item 13 refuses
does_not_establish.that_a_chain_is_impossible: the two missing blocks are ordinary design work; what is established is that they are MISSING, so the acceptance's premise -- that RE8 and T64 existing is enough -- is not yet true
does_not_establish.the_boundary: no dependent-boundary cycle count is measured here and none is reported.  technology.json#latency.pipeline_fill_drain_s stays graded 'assumed' and G4's boundary item stays unmet

measured.method: for each signal, a generated one-line module instantiates ot_a3_tile64_top and connects a wire to that signal by name.  Both elaborators are run.  A port elaborates; an internal net is refused, with the refusal quoted.  The verdicts are the tools', not this file's, and expect_port records what the campaign requires them to be so that a change in either direction fails here

terms.term: the reduction over the producer's partials

terms.note: nothing drives the endpoint's in_valid / in_leaf / in_leaf_count / in_tag from a tile's partial port.  In the T64 vehicle those are top-level INPUTS and the checker drives them from captured partials

nothing writes a tree root into a consumer tile's activation FIFO or advances act_ready_kblocks; in the T64 vehicle the activation write port is an internal net driven by a bench H-tree model out of a preloaded image

what_would_measure_it: design and qualify a partial collector: the tile's 64 x binary32 partial port into the endpoint's 8-leaf vector, in the tree's leaf order, with the K-block as the tag
design and qualify an operand receiver: a tree root off the link into a consumer tile's activation FIFO word, with act_ready_kblocks advanced when a slice is complete
then chain two ot_a3_tile64 through them and measure, on both simulators, the cycles from the producer's last partial write to the consumer's first lane-op
